svg.aria-label: One marketplace, MIT: Ships as the Claude Code marketplace claude-development-skills: 81 skills in 8 plugins, licensed MIT. Stacks it covers: React 19 / Vue 3 · Hono / Go / FastAPI · Supabase / Next 16 · Vercel / Hetzner / IONOS · Rust + Bevy. No change on a second run: Reads your stack profile first, applies only the missing move, and changes nothing on a second run. Judgment, not dogma: Every rule ships with its when to deviate. The aim is judgment, not dogma
